author: Conductor Rebuild
independent_safety_tests: accepted retries keep original turns, deduplicate and stay ahead of later submissions
a failed continuation pauses the remaining retry until the existing resume action
deleting an accepted queued retry prevents its delivery
a saved edit becomes a new turn without rewriting the original failed message
a retry whose original turn was reset away cannot leave the queue working
explicitly steering a queued retry preserves its original turn identity
ownership: Minimal queue carrier, retry enqueue, edit marker strip and runtime guard/dispatch only. No producer/auth/card/Transcript/WV/parser/persistence changes. Existing frozen attachment candidate unapplied and unchanged.
